## Module 13. 保守性分析（supportive analysis）

分析差异Peak的进化保守性，识别功能重要的区域。

```{r conservation_analysis}
if(nrow(res_df) == 0) {
  cat("没有差异Peak,跳过保守性分析。\n")
  write_skipped_state(
    "Step13",
    "Conservation_Analysis",
    "No differential peaks detected.",
    clear_plot_files = c("GC_Content_Distribution.pdf", "GC_vs_FoldChange.pdf", "PhastCons_Distribution.pdf", "PhastCons_vs_FoldChange.pdf")
  )
} else {

  mm39_levels <- seqlevels(BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm39)

  normalize_to_ucsc <- function(gr) {
    if(length(gr) == 0) return(gr)
    if(!any(grepl("^chr", seqlevels(gr)))) {
      # Rename levels (automatically updates seqnames)
      seqlevels(gr) <- paste0("chr", seqlevels(gr))
    }
    # Rename MT to M if present
    if("chrMT" %in% seqlevels(gr)) {
      new_levels <- seqlevels(gr)
      new_levels[new_levels == "chrMT"] <- "chrM"
      seqlevels(gr) <- new_levels
    }
    keepSeqlevels(gr, intersect(seqlevels(gr), mm39_levels), pruning.mode = "coarse")
  }

  peaks_step10 <- normalize_to_ucsc(dba_res)

  if(length(peaks_step10) == 0) {
    cat("差异Peak的坐标与mm39不匹配,跳过保守性分析。\n")
    write_skipped_state(
      "Step13",
      "Conservation_Analysis",
      "Differential peaks could not be mapped to primary mm39 UCSC chromosomes.",
      clear_plot_files = c("GC_Content_Distribution.pdf", "GC_vs_FoldChange.pdf", "PhastCons_Distribution.pdf", "PhastCons_vs_FoldChange.pdf")
    )
  } else {
    run_phast_cons <- env_bool("ATAC_RUN_PHASTCONS", FALSE)
    phast_cons <- if(run_phast_cons) {
      tryCatch(getGScores("phastCons35way.UCSC.mm39"), error = function(e) {
        cat("无法加载phastCons35way.UCSC.mm39,仅计算GC含量。\n")
        NULL
      })
    } else {
      write_skipped_state(
        "Step13",
        "PhastCons_Module",
        "ATAC_RUN_PHASTCONS is false; phastCons35way.UCSC.mm39 was not loaded. GC-content analysis was still generated."
      )
      NULL
    }

    seq_lengths <- seqlengths(BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm39)[as.character(seqnames(peaks_step10))]
    in_bounds <- !is.na(seq_lengths) & start(peaks_step10) >= 1 & end(peaks_step10) <= seq_lengths
    bounds_filter_summary <- data.frame(
      InputPeaks = length(peaks_step10),
      InBoundsPeaks = sum(in_bounds),
      OutOfBoundsPeaks = sum(!in_bounds),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    write.csv(bounds_filter_summary, step_table_file("Step13", "Sequence_Bounds_Filter_Summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
    if(any(!in_bounds)) {
      out_of_bounds <- data.frame(
        seqnames = as.character(seqnames(peaks_step10))[!in_bounds],
        start = start(peaks_step10)[!in_bounds],
        end = end(peaks_step10)[!in_bounds],
        seqlength = seq_lengths[!in_bounds],
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
      write.csv(out_of_bounds, step_table_file("Step13", "Out_Of_Bounds_Peaks.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
    }
    peaks_step10 <- peaks_step10[in_bounds]
    if(length(peaks_step10) == 0) {
      write_skipped_state(
        "Step13",
        "GC_Content_Analysis",
        "No differential peaks remained after filtering intervals to BSgenome mm39 chromosome bounds.",
        clear_plot_files = c("GC_Content_Distribution.pdf", "GC_vs_FoldChange.pdf", "PhastCons_Distribution.pdf", "PhastCons_vs_FoldChange.pdf")
      )
      knitr::knit_exit()
    }

    peak_ids <- paste(seqnames(peaks_step10), start(peaks_step10), end(peaks_step10), sep = ":")
    peak_seqs <- getSeq(BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm39, peaks_step10)
    gc_values <- rowSums(letterFrequency(peak_seqs, c("G", "C"), as.prob = TRUE))

    res_df_step10 <- res_df %>%
      mutate(seqnames = ensure_ucsc_seqnames(seqnames)) %>%
      mutate(seqnames = sub("chrMT", "chrM", seqnames)) %>%
      transmute(peak_id = paste(seqnames, start, end, sep = ":"),
                fold_change = Fold,
                pvalue = pvalue,
                fdr = FDR)

    diff_anno_step10 <- if(exists("diff_anno")) {
      diff_tbl <- as.data.frame(diff_anno)
      if("SYMBOL" %in% colnames(diff_tbl)) {
        colnames(diff_tbl)[colnames(diff_tbl) == "SYMBOL"] <- "geneSymbol"
      }
      if(!"geneSymbol" %in% colnames(diff_tbl)) {
        diff_tbl$geneSymbol <- NA_character_
      }
      diff_tbl %>%
        mutate(seqnames = ensure_ucsc_seqnames(seqnames)) %>%
        mutate(seqnames = sub("chrMT", "chrM", seqnames)) %>%
        transmute(peak_id = paste(seqnames, start, end, sep = ":"),
                  geneSymbol = geneSymbol)
    } else {
      tibble(peak_id = character(), geneSymbol = character())
    }

    conservation_df <- tibble(
      peak_id = peak_ids,
      seqnames = as.character(seqnames(peaks_step10)),
      start = start(peaks_step10),
      end = end(peaks_step10),
      gc_content = gc_values
    ) %>%
      left_join(res_df_step10, by = "peak_id") %>%
      left_join(diff_anno_step10, by = "peak_id") %>%
      mutate(RawPvalueSignificant = is.finite(pvalue) & pvalue >= 0 & pvalue < 0.05)

    if(!is.null(phast_cons)) {
      phast_gr <- gscores(phast_cons, peaks_step10)
      conservation_df$phast_cons <- mcols(phast_gr)[,1]
    } else {
      conservation_df$phast_cons <- NA_real_
    }

    gc_hist <- ggplot(conservation_df, aes(gc_content)) +
      geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = viz_pal$burden_density, alpha = 0.7) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = mean(conservation_df$gc_content), linetype = "dashed", color = viz_pal$group[comparison_group]) +
      labs(title = "GC Content Distribution of Differential Peaks",
           x = "GC Content", y = "Count") +
      theme_atac_classic(base_size = 12)

    save_gg_dual(
      gc_hist,
      file = step_plot_file("Step13", "GC_Content_Distribution.pdf"),
      width = 8,
      height = 6
    )
    print(gc_hist)

    gc_vs_fc <- ggplot(conservation_df, aes(gc_content, fold_change, color = RawPvalueSignificant)) +
      geom_point(
        data = subset(conservation_df, !(RawPvalueSignificant)),
        color = pal_pick(viz_pal$neutral_mid),
        alpha = 0.45,
        size = 1.8
      ) +
      geom_point(
        data = subset(conservation_df, RawPvalueSignificant),
        color = pal_pick(viz_pal$group[comparison_group]),
        alpha = 0.95,
        size = 2.8
      ) +
      scale_color_manual(values = pal_named(`FALSE` = viz_pal$neutral_mid, `TRUE` = viz_pal$group[comparison_group]),
                         labels = c("FALSE" = "pvalue unavailable or >= 0.05", "TRUE" = "raw pvalue < 0.05")) +
      geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = viz_pal$neutral["dark"]) +
      labs(title = "GC Content vs Fold Change",
           x = "GC Content", y = "Log2 Fold Change",
           color = "Raw pvalue") +
      theme_atac_classic(base_size = 12)

    save_plot_pdf(gc_vs_fc, step_plot_file("Step13", "GC_vs_FoldChange.pdf"), width = 8, height = 6)
    print(gc_vs_fc)

    if(!all(is.na(conservation_df$phast_cons))) {
      phast_hist <- ggplot(conservation_df, aes(phast_cons)) +
        geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = viz_pal$dmr["Hyper"], alpha = 0.7) +
        labs(title = "phastCons Conservation Scores", x = "Mean phastCons Score", y = "Count") +
        theme_atac_classic(base_size = 12)

      save_gg_dual(
        phast_hist,
        file = step_plot_file("Step13", "PhastCons_Distribution.pdf"),
        width = 8,
        height = 6
      )
      print(phast_hist)

      phast_vs_fc <- ggplot(conservation_df, aes(phast_cons, fold_change, color = RawPvalueSignificant)) +
        geom_point(
          data = subset(conservation_df, !(RawPvalueSignificant)),
          color = pal_pick(viz_pal$neutral_mid),
          alpha = 0.45,
          size = 1.8
        ) +
        geom_point(
          data = subset(conservation_df, RawPvalueSignificant),
          color = pal_pick(viz_pal$group[comparison_group]),
          alpha = 0.95,
          size = 2.8
        ) +
        scale_color_manual(values = pal_named(`FALSE` = viz_pal$neutral_mid, `TRUE` = viz_pal$group[comparison_group]),
                           labels = c("FALSE" = "pvalue unavailable or >= 0.05", "TRUE" = "raw pvalue < 0.05")) +
        labs(title = "phastCons vs Fold Change", x = "Mean phastCons Score", y = "Log2 Fold Change",
             color = "Raw pvalue") +
        theme_atac_classic(base_size = 12)

      save_plot_pdf(phast_vs_fc, step_plot_file("Step13", "PhastCons_vs_FoldChange.pdf"), width = 8, height = 6)
      print(phast_vs_fc)
    } else {
      remove_output_with_preview(step_plot_file("Step13", "PhastCons_Distribution.pdf"))
      remove_output_with_preview(step_plot_file("Step13", "PhastCons_vs_FoldChange.pdf"))
      write_skipped_state(
        "Step13",
        "PhastCons_Module",
        "All phastCons values are NA; conservation table retained but phastCons plots were not exported."
      )
    }

    write.csv(conservation_df, step_table_file("Step13", "Peak_Conservation_Analysis.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

    high_gc_peaks <- conservation_df %>% filter(gc_content > 0.5)
    write.csv(high_gc_peaks, step_table_file("Step13", "High_GC_Peaks.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

    cat("差异Peak的平均GC含量:", round(mean(conservation_df$gc_content, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
    cat("高GC含量的Peak数量 (> 0.5):", nrow(high_gc_peaks), "\n")
    if(!all(is.na(conservation_df$phast_cons))) {
      cat("差异Peak的平均phastCons分数:", round(mean(conservation_df$phast_cons, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
    }
  }
}
```
